hero.subheadline: I help pharmaceutical companies, pharmacies, drug warehouses and pharmacists market their products and services with AI: campaigns, videos, websites, content and interactive experiences — fast to produce and built to respect medicine-advertising rules.
hero.intro: Pharmacist by training, marketer by experience. Three years in pharmaceutical sales and business development showed me how medicines are really sold — to doctors, to pharmacies and to patients — and how easily a campaign can cross a regulatory line. I combine that with AI production to make marketing that is faster, more creative and safe to publish.

about.lead: I am a pharmacist and AI marketing specialist for the pharmaceutical sector, certified in AI for Business (CPD). I use AI to create marketing for pharmaceutical companies, pharmacies, distributors and healthcare professionals — and I check every claim the way a pharmacist would.
about.body:
My background spans community pharmacy, laboratory work, a COVID-19 vaccination center and three years in pharmaceutical sales and business development, with training in regulation and the drug lifecycle. That mix taught me how medicines move: from registration, to the brand, the warehouse, the pharmacy shelf and the patient.

I don’t approach marketing like an agency that has never read a leaflet. I approach it as a pharmacist who knows what a product is approved for, what may be said to the public and what only to healthcare professionals, and where a claim needs evidence. AI lets me produce campaigns, videos and websites quickly; pharmaceutical knowledge keeps them accurate and compliant.
